2021: This includes meetings with parliament from Sebei and Rwenzor Region on key SRHR issues, dissemination of the CSE case ruling, etc.2022: No sub-national level advocacy initiatives2023: This includes dissemination of YFS findings, commemoration of IWD, and commemoration of blood donor day.

2023 (second half) Total 4. This includes campaigns linked to Patient Safety Day, 16 Days of Activism, and training youth advocates.2024: Total 4. This includes facilitating trained young peers to advocate for their SRHR needs and services at district level in the Elgon region.

2022: On regional level this includes orienting MPs on EAC SRHR Bill. On national level this includes budget advocacy supporting adolescent health TWG, litigation on the ban on CSE etc.2023: This includes following UPR commitments, Y+ summit, reviewing progressive laws and policies, budget advocacy, etc.

2023 (second half): Total 12. This includes participation in technical working groups, meeting with MPs and line ministries.2024: Total 15. This includes RHNK conference (regional), follow up meetings with parliamentarians on the AHA (national) and ICPD conference (international).
